primitives.assumptions: Traits are inherited via non-Mendelian mechanisms; behavioral quirks bypass normal developmental constraints.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When environmental pressures exceed genetic predisposition thresholds.

primitives.assumptions: Instincts arise from indirect evolutionary pathways rather than direct experiential inheritance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When A(t) ≠ B(t) due to mismatched environmental adaptation.

Idiosyncratic variations act as noise terms in this kernel, manifesting as deviations from expected norms. These constructs are formalized through stochastic mappings and feedback loops, enabling Bayesian inference of trait propagation. The dualities lie in the tension between deterministic genetic encoding and probabilistic behavioral emergence. Failure modes occur when environmental pressures disrupt the kernel's stability, leading to trait divergence or loss.
